title: About
text:
About Me
I am a healthcare analytics professional interested in applying statistical modeling, data science, and research methods to complex public health challenges.
This portfolio showcases independent analytical projects, original research, and interactive applications using publicly available data.
My goal is to translate rigorous quantitative analysis into meaningful insights for healthcare organizations, researchers, and policymakers.
